comment_text: Just back home yesterday from Japan trip in may 2026. The previous trip was November 2022, and on that trip I was thinking of buying a casio mudmaster, but unfortunately due to my budget I didn't. So some 3 years later and a  better budget I had changed my goal to a Tissot seastar auto. Almost bought one v at Gotemba outlet, but I was running out of time for the pre booked bus, the sales girl was busy. Soon after that we were in Machida to visit my wifes family. Bookoff Machida had a few good priced watches including a casio gwg-b1000. Absolutely immaculate as if new, but I'm not a impulse buyer and continued looking for a seastar or similar spec watch. But thinking I would probably get the casio if it was still there the next week. Needless to say i now have the gwg-b1000, Absolutely immaculate condition and for or 1/3 the price new in Australia.
